cvs.text: Mariam Nyström is a full-stack software developer experienced in data analytics, SQL, Python, and reporting data. She combined monthly order files into a PostgreSQL database by establishing mapping tables for mismatched customer codes and screening duplicates. She utilized SQL queries to verify database records against source totals, ensuring full traceability for finance. Mariam routinely compared weekly reports against physical records to resolve discrepancies such as duplicate entries. Additionally, she designed a relational data model spanning customers, orders, and returns, complete with documented import checks for missing identifiers to ensure accurate, repeatable monthly reporting.

Eero Wei brings practical experience in building booking tools and creating spreadsheet reports. He developed web-based intake forms and resolved data discrepancies by tracing server logs to eliminate duplicate entries caused by repeated submissions. Eero established test cases covering missing data fields and repeated requests to ensure reporting reliability. His background includes creating step-by-step documentation to guide users through updating records, resolving data inaccuracies, and maintaining reliable weekly operations.

Nadia Nair possesses extensive experience in operations and business tools, focusing on structured data tracking and reporting. She eliminated duplicate processing by establishing centralized, shared order sheets and implementing disciplined team workflows. Nadia designed spreadsheets to log daily operations, comparing weekly totals to pinpoint discrepancies, track material trends, and substantially reduce waste. Experienced in maintaining accurate data systems, she creates clear instructional guides, updates formulas when external specifications change, and conducts practical checks to maintain ongoing data consistency.

Linh Hassan offers strong experience in meticulous data collection and practical testing. In workshop environments, she maintained data reliability by labelling items, recording exact parameters alongside summaries, and verifying unusual readings to prevent mismatched records. Linh frequently compared test results across repeated runs, isolating anomalies and recording findings to ensure accuracy. Her experience designing clear reference documentation with explicit instructions on handling edge cases and abnormal values directly supports building dependable data routines.
